author: Akinwale Awoyele

dataset_audit.sampling: Partial subset in inventory/download-availability order; not random or representative.

historical_macos_timing.hardware_author_reported: MacBook, Apple M5, 24 GB RAM; not independently verified in the archived record.
limitations: Each image launched a fresh OCR process; timing includes startup.
No accuracy, calibrated confidence, or occlusion robustness was measured.
Child RSS and one host RSS snapshot are not complete application peak memory and must not be added as such.
Video decoding, live transport, graphics and separate WebKit services are excluded.
Archive lacks a complete code/backend/OS version manifest; these are not measurements of every current release feature.
Image subset includes duplicates and was not sampled representatively.

implemented: macOS Apple Vision OCR, alternatives and multi-view candidate ranking
macOS imported video and RTSP latest-frame sampling without vehicle association or temporal fusion
Android bundled ML Kit image and phone-camera recognition
proposed_not_trained_or_evaluated: Visibility estimation and occlusion-aware supervised training
Calibrated complete-plate correctness and automatic acceptance
